item_PR554_landUseDiff.finding: DIVERGES in a way that matters. Not a duplicate.
details: PR #554 branched from 7cbe0bc4, which does NOT contain 7f522893 -- confirmed via git merge-base --is-ancestor. The two evolved independently against the same file (nodeFacetBakeTier1Conformant.ts) with no awareness of each other.

Both fix the same underlying defect class (landUse present-as-absent -- 7f522893 cites the 2026-08-30 review's Travis/48021 findings; #554 cites its own W0b source-of-truth finding and calls it 'A-025 present-as-absent') but with STRUCTURALLY INCOMPATIBLE mechanisms.

main (7f522893): adds a `provenance.landUseAbsence` sibling field (verdict/authority/scopeSearched/asOf/basis); baseFacts.landUse itself stays a real code-object or plain `null`; enforced by a new `assertLandUseAbsenceEarned()` guard that throws if a null landUse reaches a payload without that sibling record. Land use is additionally sourced from a NEW CAD-to-CAD prop_id roll join (`fetchCountyLandUseRoll`/`landUseJoinKey`) that #554 does not have at all.

PR #554: embeds the absence directly INSIDE baseFacts.landUse as an `AbsentVerifiedLeaf` object (same slot a real land-use code would occupy, with `code`/`source`/etc. typed as `never` to narrow) -- so landUse is non-null even when absent. Enforced by its own, differently-shaped `landUseBakeLegal()` check. Land use is sourced from a brand-new `land-use-fact.landUseCode` / `cad_property.property_use_code` 'named source' read (namedLandUseSourceFetch.ts) that main does not have at all.

Concretely: main's `assertLandUseAbsenceEarned` reads `baseFacts.landUse != null` as 'a land use was projected' and requires `facetCoverage.landUse === true` with no absence record -- it would misread #554's absence-leaf-in-the-landUse-slot as a successful projection and then fault it for carrying no `provenance.landUseAbsence`. Landing #554 as-is on top of 7f522893 would not just conflict textually, it would fight the freshly-added assertion that fixes the sprint's own target defect.

#554 additionally bundles unrelated bake work in the same commit/file: max-year tax-year selection with claim-wide field refusal, a new CAD<->TxGIO alias join (cadTxgioAliasRead.ts, read-only/no-persist per its own PR body), and an 'honest point' upsert -- none of which 7f522893 touches, making #554 a substantially larger surface than a landUse-only comparison suggests.
PR #554's live mergeStateStatus is DIRTY/CONFLICTING against current main (checked live, gh pr view 554) -- unsurprising given the above.
item_PR554_landUseDiff.recommendation: This is a semantic disagreement about where the earned-absence contract lives (a sibling provenance field vs. embedded in the value slot) and what upstream is authoritative for landUse (CAD roll prop_id join vs. land-use-fact/cad_property named source) -- not a mechanical conflict. Per the sprint's own discipline ('if ambiguity is semantic, stop and report rather than resolve it yourself'), this needs an operator/integration-seat ruling on which contract wins (or how to reconcile both) before sprint item 20's LDT serve-cutover half, or any further work on #554 itself, can proceed.
